instruction: Please configure VS Code to automatically save files after a delay. Change the auto-save setting to save files after a delay instead of never.

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing VS Code auto-save setting from 'off' (default) to 'afterDelay'. This is verified by checking the settings.json file contains 'files.autoSave': 'afterDelay'. The task maintains similar difficulty to the original - both involve modifying a single VS Code setting via the settings UI.
metadata.scoring_breakdown: 1.0 if files.autoSave is set to 'afterDelay', 0.0 otherwise

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts VS Code settings.json from standard location (/home/user/.config/Code/User/settings.json)
Metric check_json_settings correctly loads JSON and verifies the files.autoSave key has value 'afterDelay'
Expected value 'afterDelay' is the correct VS Code setting value for auto-save after delay
Complete coverage: instruction requires changing auto-save to afterDelay, evaluator checks exactly this requirement
Proper error handling: metric returns 0.0 for missing files or missing/incorrect keys
State accessibility: VS Code persists settings.json automatically when changed through UI, no postconfig needed
Data flow is correct: getter extracts right file, metric compares right setting, expected value matches requirement
